evals.name: slack-oncall
evals.prompt: I'm building a Slack bot for my team using the CopilotKit Channels SDK (@copilotkit/channels). When someone @mentions it, it should answer using our agent. It also needs a tool that looks up who is currently on call for a given team name. Write the complete bot setup code in TypeScript and save it as bot.ts.
evals.expected_output: A bot.ts using createBot with a slack adapter, agent factory, defineBotTool for on-call lookup with a Standard Schema, and bot.onMention that calls thread.runAgent(). No invented APIs.

evals.name: hitl-confirm
evals.prompt: Using the CopilotKit Channels SDK, I want a confirmation with Approve and Cancel buttons before my bot runs a destructive tool that deletes a database. Show me the code for the tool that renders the human-in-the-loop confirmation and only proceeds if the user approves. Save it as delete-tool.ts.
evals.expected_output: A defineBotTool whose handler calls thread.awaitChoice with an Actions/Button tree (values true/false) and only deletes on approval. Uses channels-ui components.

evals.name: hn-top
evals.prompt: Build a CopilotKit Channels SDK slash command called /top that posts the top 5 Hacker News stories as one interactive message. Each story should show its title and points, with a button that opens the story link. Include the Hacker News fetch. Save it as top-command.ts.
evals.expected_output: bot.onCommand('top', ...) (or defineBotCommand) that fetches HN top stories and posts a Message with per-story Section/Fields and a link Button (url=...). Uses channels-ui JSX.
